from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    bg=max({v for row in g for v in row}, key=lambda c: sum(r.count(c) for r in g))
    objs=[]
    for col in sorted({v for row in g for v in row}):
        if col==bg: continue
        for cp in comps(g,col): objs.append((col,cp))
    shapes={}
    for col,cp in objs: shapes.setdefault(norm(cp),[]).append((col,cp))
    dup=[(len(next(iter(shapes))[0:1]),k) for k in []]  # noop
    groups=[(len(k),k,v) for k,v in shapes.items() if len(v)>1]
    size,k,grp=max(groups)
    cnt=Counter(col for col,_ in objs)
    single=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==1]
    # target: singleton color whose own shape is unique among objects
    target=[c for c in single if len(shapes[norm(next(cp for col,cp in objs if col==c))])]==1
    tgt=target[0]
    top=min(grp,key=lambda t:(t[1][0],t[1][1]))  # member tuple (col,cp): topmost by min row
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in top[1]: out[r][c]=tgt
    return out
